title: RE harness fixture: model document (v1)
description: Pure-data model shared verbatim by the reference and candidate runners. One file per fixture. BPMN fixtures carry the XML text plus the derived F1 canonical model; xyflow fixtures carry a flow graph; JointJS fixtures carry a graph JSON. No fixture encodes library calls.

xml.description: Complete BPMN 2.0 XML text with BPMNDI (reference-native); present only for bpmn-xml-f1. Loaded verbatim by importXML.

model.description: Canonical model: F1 (bpmn), flow graph (xyflow) or graph JSON (jointjs). Keys are compared after canonical sort.

idCorrespondence.description: Declared id remapping between the two runs (bpmn §8.3 point 2). Must be a bijection; enforced by validateFixtures and compareEvents (C6).

extraction.description: Mechanical-extraction provenance for xyflow example fixtures (C1). status=unknown fixtures are never run green: the gate reports them unknown with the cause.

renderMutation.description: Selftest only: a real rendering mutation applied through the library API before pixel capture (C3).

pixelThreshold.description: Per-fixture pixel secondary threshold (SPEC_RE_JOINTJS_PARITY §5.3: fixed per fixture).
